About

Burnpur Cement Ltd is a formerly operating cement manufacturer that is now completely non-operational. All production assets have been sold, operating revenue has remained nil since FY25, and management and auditors assess the company as not a going concern.[1] [2]

Key Points

Current Operational status:
The operations were discontinued from November 2023, and the company had no manufacturing unit as of June 2026. Revenue remained nil in FY26 and Q1FY27. [1]
Historically, BCL manufactured Portland Slag Cement, OPC and PPC products for housing and infrastructure. Under its last operating model, the entire output was sold to UltraTech; there are no current products or customers following the asset sale. [2] [3]
